01
The club

Small club.
Serious boxing.

Whakatu isn’t a big commercial gym. It’s a coach, a ring, and a team that trains together — and that’s exactly the point.

Whakatu Boxing Club trains out of the Celtic Squash Club venue at 30 Trafalgar Street, The Wood, Nelson — sharing facilities with the neighbouring Tasman Boxing Club, and working closely with the other Nelson clubs too.

Coach Dion Hall runs a select team, taking young boxers along patiently — building combinations, confidence and ring craft before they ever step through the ropes to compete.

It’s the kind of club where the coach knows every boxer, every strength, and exactly what to work on next.
